name: Leave Request Approval Process
description: SAP Build Process Automation workflow process for reviewing and deciding on employee leave requests.

employeeName.description: Full name of the requesting employee

employeeEmail.description: Email address of the requesting employee

managerName.description: Full name of the approving manager

managerEmail.description: Email address of the approving manager

leaveType.description: Type of leave requested (e.g. Annual Leave, Sick Leave)

reason.description: Employee's stated reason for the leave

steps.name: Approve Leave Request
steps.subject: Leave Request ${context.requestNumber} for ${context.employeeName}
steps.description: Review and decide on ${context.numberOfDays} days of ${context.leaveType} requested by ${context.employeeName} (${context.fromDate} to ${context.toDate}).

steps.name: Notify Employee - Approved
steps.subject: Your Leave Request ${context.requestNumber} has been Approved
steps.content:
Dear ${context.employeeName},

Your leave request ${context.requestNumber} for ${context.numberOfDays} days of ${context.leaveType} (${context.fromDate} to ${context.toDate}) has been APPROVED by your manager.

Manager Notes: ${steps.step_manager_approval.decisionComment || 'None'}

Best regards,
HR Team

steps.name: Notify Employee - Rejected
steps.subject: Your Leave Request ${context.requestNumber} has been Rejected
steps.content:
Dear ${context.employeeName},

Your leave request ${context.requestNumber} for ${context.numberOfDays} days of ${context.leaveType} (${context.fromDate} to ${context.toDate}) was not approved by your manager.

Manager Notes: ${steps.step_manager_approval.decisionComment || 'No reason provided'}

Best regards,
HR Team
